outcome: A repo vendored before the factory/ rename can now be carried onto the current harness in one command. `forge upgrade` detects the legacy .agents/ layout, carries the project's skills across, deletes the old tree only once every file left in it is provably the machinery being replaced, and otherwise refuses before writing anything — so a refusal leaves a clean repo you can repair and re-run. It then names the project-owned files still mentioning the retired path instead of editing them. `forge stage migrate --base <sha>` gives a story that was open at upgrade time a measurement origin, so it can still be closed. Four client repos were stranded with no migration path; decision 0016 promised them one and this is it.
